title: 004 怀孕

content_zh:
白薇大学时模特出道, 因模样清纯, 在网上火速红了起来, 娱乐圈不是谁都能进的, 白薇没有人脉, 一直没什么资源，不温不火的，却有些曝光度, 最起码说起来，大家都记得有她这号人物，后来她认识了封陵游, 没脸没皮也要和封陵游在一起, 按理说一般人做小三都会低调，可这姑娘似乎是怕封家不认账, 时时刻刻要跟封家扯上关系, 哪怕被人说是小三, 也要坐实这段关系。
“白薇你怀孕了吗？”
“你怀的是封家后代吗？”
“有人传你和封陵游已经领证了, 这是真的吗？”
白薇闻言, 没有否认, 只羞红了脸，捧着胸口说：
“让大家担心了，我没事, 只是最近总是莫名其妙地呕吐, 吃什么都没胃口。”
记者一听，更激动，一个个对着她的脸和肚子拍，白薇竟然也不拒绝，捂着胸口，脸色苍白，看起来我见犹怜。
苏檀乐了。
敢情这还是鸿门宴！果然是宴无好宴！不过眼前的白薇长得倒是很清纯，皮肤白白的，眼睛大大的，脸型也不错，一袭白裙看起来要多清纯有多清纯，难怪当初被冠以“国民初恋”的名号，只是她做起事来倒是很有手段，和她外表看起来大不相同。
记者们问了一圈，也拍的差不多了，半晌才看清白薇的边上还站着一个人，当下问：
“这位是……白薇的新助理？”
“不是吧？我怎么瞅着她像封陵游的原配呢？他们离婚了么？”
白薇闻言，猛地扑到苏檀怀里，掐住苏檀的手，干笑道：
“是！她正是姐姐！我们约出来一起喝咖啡。”
“你们感情真好！”记者又问：“那封太太不介意您和封陵游的事吗？”
白薇一脸哀伤地回答：“许多事真的不是大家想的那样，感情的事谁又说得出对错呢？”
记者们一看，当下猛拍起来，这可不得了！他们原以为这位女士是白薇的新助理，但见对方长相出众，颜值完全是圈内人的标准，觉得不敢肯定，谁知道白薇爆了猛料，对方是封陵游的妻子！这可是爆炸性新闻啊！原配跟小三约在咖啡店喝咖啡！如此和平共处，难不成白薇真的不是小三？原配和封陵游已经离婚了？
“封太太，请问你们真的情如姐妹吗？”
“封太太，你和封陵游先生的关系如何？你们真的如外界所说，已经离婚了么？”
一个个问题轰过来，让苏檀眉头紧蹙，偏偏一旁的白薇靠她靠得很近，整个人都要贴上来了，白薇身上香水味很浓，让苏檀脑子更疼了。

只是……
讲道理，小三拉正室来博版面，白薇这波操作真是厉害！
白薇到底怎么想的？还是说以前的苏檀真的懦弱到了这个地步，连这种事情都能忍？让人骑到头上了，还要维持自己封太太的形象？
然而，她可不是原身！让人如此拿捏！
苏檀不觉勾起唇角笑了。
等她回答？好！她就好好回答！
苏檀对着众人笑笑：“情如姐妹就算了，你们见过哪家原配跟小三情如姐妹的？”
这话一出，一旁的白薇脸顿时涨的通红，她一脸焦急，想拦住苏檀，谁知苏檀却继续笑眯眯地回答：
“还有这位记者朋友，我和封陵游什么时候离婚的，我怎么不知道？”
这话一出，记者们彻底爆了，没离婚？可白薇明明多次对外爆料，说已经离婚，还放出她和封陵游结婚的消息，说什么正在准备婚礼，敢情一切都是假的？人家正室还在呢，离婚都是空谈。
眼前的苏檀笑眯眯的，语气极好，哪怕是大家打听她的家事，她也不气，这样子倒是颇有正室风范，一时间，大家眼神复杂地看向白薇，都在心里说，这小三和正室果真是不一样！就人家这气度，就不是她白薇能比的。
大家纷纷打听：
“你们没离婚？也就是说，白薇小姐是你们婚姻的第三者？”
“封太太，您对白小姐怀孕一事怎么看？”
“封太太，白薇小姐怀孕，封家会如何处置这个孩子？会让白小姐进门吗？”
记者们真是八卦，问题一个比一个犀利，苏檀心里一哂，看向白薇笑道：
“白薇小姐是不是第三者，这不是明摆着的事情吗？”
苏檀的话一句比一句直白，让白薇的脸再也挂不住了。

content_en:
Bai Wei debuted as a model in college. Due to her pure appearance, she quickly became famous on the Internet. Not everyone can enter the entertainment industry. Bai Wei has no connections and has never had any resources. She is tepid, but she has some exposure. At least everyone remembers her as a character. Later she met Fengling You, and she wanted to be with Fengling You despite being shameless. Normally, most people would keep a low profile when they are mistresses, but this girl seems to be afraid that the Feng family will not admit it. You must have a relationship with the Feng family at all times, even if you are said to be a mistress, you must maintain this relationship.
"Bai Wei, are you pregnant?"
"Are you pregnant with a descendant of the Feng family?"
"Some people say that you and Fenglingyou have obtained the certificate. Is this true?"
When Bai Wei heard this, she did not deny it. She only blushed with embarrassment, held her chest and said:
"I'm worrying everyone. I'm fine. It's just that I've been vomiting for no reason recently and I have no appetite for anything."
When the reporters heard this, they became even more excited. They patted her face and belly one by one. Bai Wei didn't even refuse. She covered her chest and looked pale. She looked pitiful.
Su Tan was happy.
I bet this is still the Hongmen Banquet! Sure enough, there is no such thing as a good feast! However, the Bai Wei in front of her looks very pure, with fair skin, big eyes, and a good face shape. She looks so pure and innocent in a white dress. No wonder she was named the "National First Love", but she is very capable in doing things, which is very different from her appearance.
The reporters asked around and almost took pictures. It took a while to see clearly that there was another person standing next to Bai Wei, and they immediately asked:
"This is... Bai Wei's new assistant?"
"Isn't it? Why do I look at her like Fenglingyou's first wife? Are they divorced?"
When Bai Wei heard this, she rushed into Su Tan's arms, pinched Su Tan's hand, and laughed dryly:
"Yes! She is exactly my sister! Let's make an appointment to have coffee together."
"You guys have such a good relationship!" The reporter asked again, "Does Mrs. Feng mind about you and Fengling You?"
Bai Wei replied with a sad face: "Many things are really not what everyone thinks. Who can say right or wrong about emotional matters?"
When the reporters saw it, they immediately started taking pictures. This was incredible! They originally thought that this lady was Bai Wei's new assistant, but seeing that she was outstanding in appearance and her appearance was completely within the standards of insiders, they were not sure. Who knew that Bai Wei broke the news that the other party was Fenglingyou's wife! This is breaking news! The original wife made an appointment with the mistress to drink coffee in a coffee shop! With such peaceful coexistence, is it possible that Bai Wei is really not the mistress? The first wife and Fenglingyou have divorced?
"Mrs. Feng, are you really like sisters?"
"Mrs. Feng, how is your relationship with Mr. Feng Lingyou? Are you really divorced as the outside world says?"
Questions came one after another, making Su Tan frown, but Bai Wei on the side leaned very close to her, almost pressing against her. Bai Wei's perfume was very strong, which made Su Tan's head hurt even more.
Just...
To be fair, the mistress invited the main wife to post on the blog. Bai Wei's operation is really amazing!
What on earth was Bai Wei thinking? Or is it that the former Su Tan was really so cowardly that he could even endure such a thing? You have let others take advantage of you, but you still want to maintain your image as Mrs. Feng?
However, she is not the original person! It makes people so confident!
Su Tan unconsciously raised the corners of her lips and smiled.
Wait for her answer? good! She answered it nicely!
Su Tan smiled at everyone: "Forget it, they are like sisters. Have you seen any family where the first wife and the mistress are like sisters?"
As soon as these words came out, Bai Wei's face turned red immediately. She looked anxious and wanted to stop Su Tan, but Su Tan continued to reply with a smile:
"And this journalist friend, when did Fenglingyou and I divorce? Why didn't I know?"
As soon as these words came out, the reporters completely exploded. No divorce? But Bai Weiming broke the news many times that she was divorced.They also released news that she and Fengling You were getting married, saying that they were preparing for the wedding. Is it true that everything was false? The main wife is still here, so divorce is just empty talk.
The Su Tan in front of her was smiling and her tone was very good. She was not angry even if people asked about her family affairs. She looked like a royal wife. For a moment, everyone looked at Bai Wei with complicated eyes, and they all said in their hearts that this mistress is really different from the main wife! As for his demeanor, Bai Wei couldn't compare to her.
Everyone asked:
"You are not divorced? In other words, Miss Bai Wei is the third party in your marriage?"
"Mrs. Feng, what do you think about Miss Bai's pregnancy?"
"Mrs. Feng, Miss Bai Wei is pregnant. What will the Feng family do with this child? Will they let Miss Bai in?"
The reporters were really gossipy, and each question was sharper than the last. Su Tan was heartbroken, looked at Bai Wei and said with a smile:
"Isn't it obvious that Miss Bai Wei is a third party?"
Su Tan's words became more and more straightforward, and Bai Wei couldn't hold back anymore.
